content: विपरिवृत् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To turn round, revolve (<ab>fig.</ab> also); हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते <ls>Bg. 9. 10</ls>. .²2 To roll about; भूमौ विपरिवर्तेत <ls>Ms. 6. 22</ls>. .²3 To wander about, move to and fro. .²4 To return. .²5 To surround; attend upon (with <ab>acc.</ab>); दुःखं सुतेन सततं जनान् विपरिवर्तते <ls>Mb. 12. 139. 64</ls>.
